brand.name: Momentum Athletics
values: built to be used, not displayed
brand.positioning: Technical running product for people who came to running through other people. We sponsor the group run, not the podium.

campaigns.name: Track Club Collection
learnings: Style-led creators drove the highest consideration lift to date.
Momentum was the signal that best predicted which creators overdelivered.

campaigns.name: Trail Capsule Launch
learnings: Trail audience converted well but skewed older than target.
Long lead time meant we launched after the seasonal peak.

campaigns.name: Spring Tempo Drop
learnings: Fastest activation we have run, and it showed in the results.
Creators new to us outperformed repeat partners.

campaigns.name: City Half Marathon Push
learnings: Race-adjacent content outperformed studio content by a wide margin.
Mid-tier creators beat the one large creator on cost per engaged view.

campaigns.name: Recovery Line
learnings: Audience fit carried this one; the product was niche but well targeted.
Creators with prior results underdelivered relative to their scores.

campaigns.name: Winter Layer System
learnings: Strong brand fit did not rescue weak topical momentum.
Overlap was too high — three creators reached the same audience.

campaigns.name: Summer Singlet
learnings: Launched two weeks after the heat wave broke — timing cost us.
Confirms that momentum at launch matters more than creator size.

campaigns.name: Run Club Pilot
learnings: Small budget, best efficiency of any campaign in the ledger.
Community creators with no prior brand history were the top performers.

insights.overlap_finding: Campaigns with more duplicated audience have performed worse.

trend.name: Social Running Clubs
trend.description: Run clubs have shifted from training groups to social infrastructure — people join to meet people, and the run is the excuse. City-level clubs are spawning weekly, with post-run coffee as the actual product.
trend.why_now: Club formation and 'join a run club' intent are both climbing fast and have not peaked. Content in this space is community-led, so credibility beats production value — brands can enter without feeling like an ad.

citations.title: Run clubs are the new dating app
citations.snippet: Attendance at urban run clubs has roughly tripled year on year, with organisers reporting that social motivation now outranks fitness goals.

citations.title: The rise of the social run club
citations.snippet: New club registrations are up sharply, concentrated in the 18-30 bracket and skewing female for the first time.

citations.title: Why brands are showing up at run clubs
citations.snippet: Athletic brands are moving budget from stadium sponsorship toward neighbourhood run club partnerships.
